messages:
maria.s: Heads-up: embeddings route in eu-west1 is seeing 5-10x p99 latency for dedicated pools since 04:12 UTC. Impacting a few large customers. Can we do an expedited hotfix?
shane: ack, I'm looking. can we get a quick root cause? any config drift or model load issue?
deploy-bot: incident created: INC-2026-832. Event: high p99 embeddings latency. Affected pools: dedicated-eu-west1-emb-01..03. Suggested action: pin model variant, rollback recent infra change, or scale burst capacity.
priya: quick data point — last deploy to those pools was a runtime config push at 03:55 that changed KV cache TTL. Could be thrashing.
oncall: errors are not elevated, just latency. error budget still OK but latency SLOs are breached for key customers. We should treat as P2 and move fast.
shane: I'd prefer pin+revert config instead of full rollback. If we can pin the model binary to previous artifact (v1.9.7) and revert the TTL, should be low-risk. Need approvals to skip canary and fast-track.
maria.s: customer impact + legal notified; they asked for quick remediation. I'm requesting canary skip and 10-minute window to validate, then broad rollout.
alexk: +1 from infra. I'll prepare the revert and a pinned artifact. Deploy command (staging dry-run):
```
# pin model artifact and revert kv cache
redwoodctl deploy --cluster dedicated-eu-west1-emb-01 --artifact redwood/emb-model:v1.9.7 --env OVERRIDE_KV_TTL=3600 --no-canary --force
```
priya: small ask — add a smoke test that runs 10 sample embeddings and checks p99 < 200ms. If that passes we rollout.
oncall: agree. also ensure we have fallback routing to hosted-inference as a safety net for the 3 customers. document failover map: cust-A->eu-hosted, cust-B->us-hosted.
deploy-bot: Authorization required: 3 approvers for canary skip on production. Approvers: @maria.s, @shane, @priya. Reaction window: 15m.
maria.s: approved. :white_check_mark:
shane: approved, will monitor smoke tests. :eyes:
priya: approved. will sign off smoke test results.
alexk: kicking off pinned deploy now. ETA ~6min. Logs:
```
[04:18:10] pushing artifact redwood/emb-model:v1.9.7 to pool dedicated-eu-west1-emb-01
[04:19:02] apply env OVERRIDE_KV_TTL=3600
[04:19:40] deploy started (no-canary)
```
maria.s: posting quick release note draft to #release-notes after validation: "hotfix: pin embeddings model to v1.9.7, revert KV cache TTL change; mitigates p99 latency spike for dedicated eu-west1"
priya: smoke tests running: 10/10 samples complete. p99=180ms, p50=45ms. tagging: smoke-pass.
oncall: monitoring dashboards show p99 tail coming down. keep 0/3 pools under watch for 15m. set alert threshold: p99 > 400ms -> auto-rollback.
shane: note for ops: if any pool shows memory thrash, immediately scale to burst capacity and trigger manual rollback tag redwood/emb-model:v1.9.6-rollback.
deploy-bot: deploy completed to pools 01..03. post-deploy healthcheck: OK. Auto-notify scheduled in 15m for final signoff.
maria.s: final approval to promote to EU-wide? We should expand if no regressions in 15.
priya: give it 15. if smoke still green, promote and update release notes with link to customer incident and mitigation steps.
alexk: promoting to full eu-west1 now. Note: rollout flag set to 80%渐 and then 100% (staged).
(15m later)
oncall: 04:40 status: p99 stable at 165ms across dedicated pools. No errors. Recommend close.
maria.s: closing incident INC-2026-832. release note updated:
- Hotfix: pinned embeddings model to v1.9.7 for eu-west1 dedicated pools. Reverted KV cache TTL change that caused cache thrash.
- Validation: smoke tests and p99 telemetry verified; fallback routes enabled for sensitive customers.
- Rollback plan: if regression observed, tag redwood/emb-model:v1.9.6-rollback and run `redwoodctl rollback --tag v1.9.6-rollback --pools dedicated-eu-west1-*`
shane: nice work. Recommend a postmortem doc to eng-runtime with timeline and root cause (KV TTL regression), and a checklist change so future TTL changes require canary TTL ramping.
maria.s: added postmortem task to backlog and assigned to @pri/eng-runtime. :memo:
deploy-bot: incident INC-2026-832 resolved. Metrics normalized.
alexk: leaving a small tech note for release: "investigate why KV cache TTL change didn't run in staging; improve config rollout gating."
priya: closing thread. :tada:
